items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: I had to get after Mickey myself, see, because he's the one that sold it to -- did business with RCA.

ctx.x: -- it's from Mickey Goldsen. I said, 'Mickey, when you're going to send me a nice big fat check for the 'Crawfish Blues?' And he starts laughing. 49 cents after 16 years. But that's all right.
But that's a lot of fun, though, you know.
